content.text: counted it to him for righteousness, Gen. 15:6 (Rom. 4:3; Gal. 3:6; James 2:23; D&C 132:36). in righteousness shalt thou judge, Lev. 19:15. shall be our righteousness, if we observe to do all, Deut. 6:25. Not for thy righteousness … dost thou go, Deut. 9:5. Lord render to every man his righteousness, 1 Sam. 26:23. to give him according to his righteousness, 1 Kgs. 8:32 (2 Chr. 6:23). shall judge the world in righteousness, Ps. 9:8. righteous Lord loveth righteousness, Ps. 11:7. will behold thy face in righteousness, Ps. 17:15. he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness, Ps. 23:3. He loveth righteousness and judgment, Ps. 33:5 (45:7; Heb. 1:9). Thy righteousness is like the great mountains, Ps. 36:6. he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, Ps. 37:6. in thy majesty ride prosperously because of … righteousness, Ps. 45:4. heavens shall declare his righteousness, Ps. 50:6 (97:6). Thy righteousness also, O God, is very high, Ps. 71:19. righteousness shall look down from heaven, Ps. 85:11 (Moses 7:62). he shall judge the world with righteousness, Ps. 96:13 (98:9). his righteousness endureth for ever, Ps. 111:3 (2 Cor. 9:9). Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness, Ps. 132:9. righteousness delivereth from death, Prov. 10:2 (11:4). to him that soweth righteousness, Prov. 11:18. way of righteousness is life, Prov. 12:28. Righteousness keepeth him that is upright in the way, Prov. 13:6. Righteousness exalteth a nation, Prov. 14:34. Lord … loveth him that followeth after righteousness, Prov. 15:9. throne is established by righteousness, Prov. 16:12. He that followeth after righteousness and mercy findeth life, righteousness, Prov. 21:21. with righteousness shall he judge the poor, Isa. 11:4 (2 Ne. 21:4). inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness, Isa. 26:9. I lay to the line, and righteousness to the plummet, Isa. 28:17. work of righteousness shall be peace, Isa. 32:17. let the skies pour down righteousness, Isa. 45:8. thy righteousness shall go before thee, Isa. 58:8. he put on righteousness as a breastplate, Isa. 59:17. Gentiles shall see thy righteousness, Isa. 62:2. he shall be called, The Lord Our Righteousness, Jer. 23:6 (33:16). Branch of righteousness to grow up unto David, Jer. 33:15. When a righteous man doth turn from his righteousness, Ezek. 3:20 (18:24, 26; 33:18; 3 Ne. 7:15). righteousness of the righteous shall be upon him, Ezek. 18:20. in his righteousness that he hath done he shall live, Ezek. 18:22. break off thy sins by righteousness, Dan. 4:27. righteousness belongeth unto thee, Dan. 9:7. that turn many to righteousness, Dan. 12:3. Sow to yourselves in righteousness, Hosea 10:12. righteousness as a mighty stream, Amos 5:24. seek righteousness, Zeph. 2:3. offering in righteousness, Mal. 3:3 (3 Ne. 24:3; D&C 13; 128:24; JS—H 1:69).

thus it becometh us to fulfil all righteousness, Matt. 3:15 (2 Ne. 31:5). they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness, Matt. 5:6 (3 Ne. 12:6). persecuted for righteousness’ sake, Matt. 5:10 (1 Pet. 3:14). except your righteousness shall exceed the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees, Matt. 5:20 (3 Ne. 12:20). seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness, Matt. 6:33 (3 Ne. 13:33). John came unto you in the way of righteousness, Matt. 21:32. reprove the world … of righteousness, John 16:8. he that … worketh righteousness, is accepted, Acts 10:35. child of the devil, thou enemy of all righteousness, Acts 13:10. he will judge the world in righteousness, Acts 17:31. righteousness of God revealed from faith to faith, Rom. 1:17. if the uncircumcision keep the righteousness of the law, Rom. 2:26. righteousness of God without the law is manifested, Rom. 3:21. declare his righteousness for the remission of sins, Rom. 3:25. by the righteousness of one the free gift came, Rom. 5:18. might grace reign through righteousness, Rom. 5:21. yield yourselves unto God … as instruments of righteousness, Rom. 6:13. righteousness of the law might be fulfilled in us, Rom. 8:4. Spirit is life because of righteousness, Rom. 8:10. he will finish the work, and cut it short in righteousness, Rom. 9:28 (D&C 52:11). even the righteousness which is of faith, Rom. 9:30 (10:3–10; Philip. 3:8–11). ignorant of God’s righteousness … establish their own righteousness, Rom. 10:3. Christ is the end of the law for righteousness, Rom. 10:4. kingdom of God is not meat and drink; but righteousness, Rom. 14:17. Awake to righteousness, and sin not, 1 Cor. 15:34. by the armour of righteousness, 2 Cor. 6:7 (2 Ne. 1:23). increase the fruits of your righteousness, 2 Cor. 9:10 (Philip. 1:9–11). if righteousness come by the law, Gal. 2:21. verily righteousness should have been by the law, Gal. 3:21. created in righteousness, Eph. 4:24. fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness, Eph. 5:9. having on the breastplate of righteousness, Eph. 6:14 (D&C 27:16). follow after righteousness, 1 Tim. 6:11 (2 Tim. 2:22). scripture … is profitable for … instruction in righteousness, 2 Tim. 3:16. laid up for me a crown of righteousness, 2 Tim. 4:8. Not by works of righteousness which we have done, Titus 3:5. Thou hast loved righteousness, Heb. 1:9. being by interpretation King of righteousness, Heb. 7:2. Noah … became heir of the righteousness, Heb. 11:7 (2 Pet. 2:5). through faith subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, Heb. 11:33. yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness, Heb. 12:11 (James 3:18). wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God, James 1:20. being dead to sins, should live unto righteousness, 1 Pet. 2:24. not to have known the way of righteousness, 2 Pet. 2:21. new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness, 2 Pet. 3:13. every one that doeth righteousness is born of him, 1 Jn. 2:29. whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, 1 Jn. 3:10. fine linen is the righteousness of saints, Rev. 19:8. in righteousness he doth judge, Rev. 19:11.

river, continually running into the fountain of all righteousness, 1 Ne. 2:9. armed with righteousness, 1 Ne. 14:14. because of the righteousness … Satan has no power, 1 Ne. 22:26. if there be no righteousness there be no happiness, 2 Ne. 2:13. encircle me around in the robe of thy righteousness, 2 Ne. 4:33 (D&C 109:76). perfect knowledge of … their righteousness, 2 Ne. 9:14. righteousness shall be the girdle of his loins, 2 Ne. 30:11. law of Moses … sanctified unto us for righteousness, Jacob 4:5. becometh an enemy to all righteousness, Mosiah 2:37 (4:14; Alma 34:23; 3 Ne. 6:28). Lord hath … judged of thy righteousness, Mosiah 3:4. nourish them with things pertaining to righteousness, Mosiah 23:18. state of righteousness, being redeemed of God, Mosiah 27:25. death, as to things pertaining unto righteousness, Alma 5:42 (12:16; Hel. 14:18). ye are in the paths of righteousness, Alma 7:19. God … doth work righteousness, Alma 26:8. Christ … is the word of truth and righteousness, Alma 38:9. Condemning the righteous because of their righteousness, Hel. 7:5. In righteousness shalt thou be established, 3 Ne. 22:14. Son of Righteousness arise with healing in his wings, 3 Ne. 25:2. come unto the fountain of all righteousness, Ether 8:26 (12:28). he even saw the Son of Righteousness, Ether 9:22. it is not counted unto him for righteousness, Moro. 7:7. conquer the enemy of all righteousness, Moro. 9:6.

know, all things … pertaining unto things of righteousness, D&C 11:14. work righteousness, shall receive a crown, D&C 20:14 (25:15). dwell in righteousness with men on earth, D&C 29:11. liveth in righteousness shall be changed, D&C 43:32. anxiously engaged … bring to pass much righteousness, D&C 58:27. offer a sacrifice unto the Lord thy God in righteousness, D&C 59:8. doeth the works of righteousness shall receive his reward, D&C 59:23. man should take righteousness in his hands, D&C 63:37. honor those who serve me in righteousness, D&C 76:5. rewarded for thy righteousness, D&C 98:30. pure people, that will serve me in righteousness, D&C 100:16. decisions … are to be made in all righteousness, D&C 107:30. handled only upon the principles of righteousness, D&C 121:36. unchanging scepter of righteousness and truth, D&C 121:46. thou shalt meet him who rejoiceth and worketh righteousness, D&C 133:44.

they were preachers of righteousness, Moses 6:23. land of righteousness unto this day, Moses 6:41. one heart and one mind, and dwelt in righteousness, Moses 7:18. having been myself a follower of righteousness, Abr. 1:2. present the various events … in truth and righteousness, JS—H 1:2.
